entity_types: Association declared under the French law of 1 July 1901 (still in force in Congo-Brazzaville); legal personality on declaration to the prefecture, receipt (récépissé) from the Ministry of Interior; ONG status by ministerial decree.
cost_time: Creation tax 15,000 FCFA (~$23) per 2025 local guide; no official fee schedule published; processing time unpublished (as of 2026); ONG decree adds further unpublished administrative delay.
foreign_no_presence: partial - no statutory bar on foreign founders, but the filing needs a legalized local legal seat and national ID copies for every executive-body member, so a remote founder requires a local office and Congolese executive/representative; filings in French.
corrections: Mechanism confirmed officially (1901 law; prefectural recépissés in JO through 2026); fee 15,000 FCFA per local guide, time unpublished; confidence med.
